headline: Executive order sets which Department of Labor officials would temporarily lead the department if top leaders are unavailable.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order lays out an order of succession within the Department of Labor. That means it lists which officials would step in to act as Secretary of Labor if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. No summary was provided, so the specific positions and their order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They may be called on to serve as acting head of the department, in the order the executive order sets, if higher-ranking leaders are unavailable.
